> ANT-X Micro is a project to build a miniature six-legged robotic ant that behaves like a real ant. For PCB Week, I'm designing a compact custom circuit board using an ESP32-C3, a DRV8833 motor driver, sensor interfaces, and battery management. The robot will control its legs, detect obstacles, and respond to danger independently, while an external computer handles more advanced AI, navigation, learning, and memory through Wi-Fi. My goal is to create a functional, compact PCB that can eventually fit inside a tiny robotic ant. This is the first step toward building a complete autonomous ant-inspired robot.
